'''Enna Lands''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] native to [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] and the mother of [[Roan Lands]]. Together with her husband [[Alexir Lands|Alexir]], Enna lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ussa]].<ref name="LOTJATE" />
